title: Monthly drop-in sessions for Cochrane authors
html:
We are now offering regular drop-in sessions for authors supported by Cochrane Oral Health.

 We are available for an online discussion about your Cochrane protocol or review on the following days:

  • Thursday 17 September 2026
  • Friday 23 October 2026

If you would like to book a meeting with us on any of these days, please use this form.

If you would like to arrange another time, please contact us by email.
